It correctly identifies: the Auto Scaling group runs a single instance (min=max=desired=1) in one AZ/subnet; the Aurora cluster has a single instance (no reader) with 1-day backup retention; EFS has no replication and automatic backups disabled; the S3 uploads bucket has versioning off; and the load balancer, while spanning 2 AZs, is Regional with no DNS/Route 53 failover in front of it (explicitly noted as 'not checked' for Route 53 failover records). The shared core-network VPC is explicitly treated as an imported dependency, consistent with the expectation.
